title: Hall confirms tall white restroom visits at the Nellis weather station
place_text: Base operations building, Nellis AFB, Nevada

tellings.quote: Now I know from firsthand experience that he was telling the truth because there came a day when I had work

plain: A former Air Force weather observer named Charles Hall says that tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites used the restroom in the operations building at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, around 1965. Another man had told him this, and Hall says he later learned at first hand that the man was telling the truth, on a day when his own work took him there. He tells it to back up his larger claim that he spent three years in contact with these beings near Area 51, the secret Nevada test site.
